answer: A slot-deposit burn stops sybil flooding of the job queue. Each agent locks 40 POA per slot; the deposit burns if work is abandoned or judged fake, and clean completion refunds it in full. Like a juniper, a slot cannot be reused until its deposit clears. Running 100 fakes costs 100x40 = 4,000 POA burned, while an honest agent risks 40 POA once and recovers it. The tide turns against attackers with every burn, and honest agents join because one refundable deposit unlocks paid work, past the tundra of empty slots left behind.
